svg.title: The recommended 0805 footprint
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale. The recommended 0805 (2012 metric) footprint: two pads 0.9 mm long and 1.4 mm wide on a 1.8 mm pitch, leaving a 0.9 mm gap. The 2.0 × 1.25 mm part sits with both metal ends on the pads.

g.text: Enlarged and drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Footprint from the table in PCB-DFA-029.
